content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkTpTxConfirmation callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_SEND [SWS_COM_00917] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].
